name: B10-0214/2025 (Verts/ALE) – Targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo – defending religious freedom and security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted attacks against Christians in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: defending religious freedom and security
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for action on the violence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where armed groups and some government soldiers have killed and abused civilians, many of them Christians. It asks the European Union to sanction those responsible, support justice, press neighbouring countries to withdraw troops and stop backing armed groups, and suspend military and mining cooperation with Rwanda until the Congo's territory is respected. It also urges talks and a ceasefire. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to suspend its raw materials deal with Rwanda and ban mineral imports and weapons exports.
- People affected: civilians in eastern Congo, especially Christians, and Rwanda's government and army.
- Next: EU governments and the Commission decide whether to act on these requests.
